findings.summary: Rows are grouped by semantic checksum contract, while memory counters remain runtime-specific.
The aggregated 1 GiB+ JavaScript full-string rows contain no 200 MiB/s bounded-memory counterexample.
The external baselines keep Woodstox and quick-xml visible as non-JS comparators under the same checksum contract.
